title: Cancer (1)
excerpt: Since I carried the genetic expression for cancer ”the demise of my predecessors” I was already following a plant-based regimen.
content:
Since I carried the genetic expression for cancer ”the demise of my predecessors” I was already following a plant-based regimen. Despite my studying nutritional protocols and all of my applied knowledge, this horrid disease continued to take over. However, I knew that an optimal nutritional application was available somewhere, so I continued to explore and experiment. I adopted a vegan diet by the time I was twenty-years-old, and have found greater downsides with the consumption of animal food when seeking true healing. I spent a year detoxifying my body via various means, including Rudolf Breuss' juice fast. I understood that refraining from solid food causes the body to eat up the diseased area before turning on healthy tissue. Within one year, the brain tumor healed by 75 percent.

Ten years later, when the osteosarcoma was diagnosed, I further employed a pure live-food dietary practice and applied multiple modalities including cleanses, ozone, photodynamic therapy, wheatgrass therapy, hyperbaric oxygen, hydrogen peroxide, Reiki, Neuro-Linguistic Programming, Qigong, Thought Field Therapy, the Emotional Freedom Technique, prayer and a lot of exercise. For the past twenty years I have eaten a 90 to 95 percent live-food diet and I'm full of life and energy.

I believe that food is medicine and that anyone in this situation can achieve great results once they have the desire to change and attain self-healing. There has been such a gap between orthodox recommendations and nurturing the creation of a self-healing environment within the body, that I wanted to share my story and leave a legacy of hope for everyone in similar circumstances. I have worked on a one-to-one basis with hundreds of patients. Investigating personal biochemistry and addressing internal and external stressors are simple techniques which provide a blueprint to success and return people to full health

It's actually quite funny now that I think back at what the doctors had told me, "Do whatever you want to in the short remaining time you have left." I've won the World Championship Powerlifting competition, pulling more than triple bodyweight to win in my age group despite serious back and shoulder injuries. I have been a British Powerlifting Champion for twenty years and world champion for five, and have won bodybuilding competitions and competed in marathons and triathlons. Power lifting at the age of 64 on a live-food diet?! In addition, I published my first book, A Living Miracle, which provides firsthand information for aiding the chronically sick to regain full health.

Ultimately, healing requires the physical, mental, emotional and spiritual levels interpenetrating throughout the entire system. Searching for healing on any level is to seek connection with its source and create unity. Regardless of your specific path, I wish you success and enlightenment on your healing journey.
